title: 1.2 Branches of Physics
description: Branches of Physics concepts and applications. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A scientist investigates how sound waves travel through walls. Which branch is being applied?
An engineer designs a telescope mirror to gather light from a distant star. Which two branches are involved?
A technician examines the magnetic field produced by a current-carrying wire. Which branch applies?
A researcher studies how thermal energy moves through a metal rod. Which branch applies?
A physicist models the behavior of an electron in an atom. Which branch applies?
A physicist calculates the path of a car during braking. Which branch applies?
Which pair of branches both involve the study of light?
A team builds an electric motor using a permanent magnet and current. Which branch is central?
A team measures the half-life of a radioactive isotope. Which branch is central?
A team studies the temperature of a gas as it expands. Which branch is central?
A team investigates why two notes sound different on the same instrument. Which branch is central?
A team predicts the orbit of a comet using laws of motion. Which branch is central?
Which description correctly separates classical and quantum mechanics?
options: Classical handles large objects; quantum handles the smallest particles
Classical studies nuclei; quantum studies planets still in the textbook
Both study only sound now in this topic in the textbook of this subject
Both study only heat transfer in physics in the textbook in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Classical handles large objects; quantum handles the smallest particles

questions.question: Which branch would a physicist choose to study the reflection of light from a mirror?
Which branch would a physicist choose to study the pitch of a siren?
Which branch would a physicist choose to study the force needed to stretch a spring?
Which set contains only branches of physics?
options: History, law and art in the textbook
Botany, zoology and ecology in class

questions.question: A scientist studies how a star produces energy in its core. Which branch is most relevant?
A scientist studies why a bridge vibrates in the wind. Which branch is most relevant?
A scientist studies how an antenna radiates signals. Which branch is most relevant?
